text: DSH Video Studio 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地视频调色工作台，在侧栏打开后可选择素材、匹配 DJI D-Log 系列 LUT，并逐步调整明暗、肤色和局部颜色。它支持画面预览、可选的 Harness 模型建议及视频导出，也提供对应的工具接口，适合希望在 Harness 中完成视频色彩处理并保存新成片的用户。使用前需在 Desktop 选择素材目录，或为 Web 配置目录授权；AI 画面分析仅在主动选择画面后发送给 Harness 当前配置的模型提供方。

DSH Video Studio adds local color editing to DeepSeek Harness. Choose clips, apply DJI LUTs, adjust tone, skin, and colors, then preview and export. Desktop users select a source folder; Web users configure access. AI image advice sends selected frames to the configured Harness model only by opt-in.
想在 DeepSeek Harness 里给 DJI Log 视频做色彩还原和调色。
我想调完视频的明暗、肤色和选定颜色，再预览并导出新文件。
I need a local video workflow to apply camera LUTs, preview color edits, and export a finished clip.
DSH Video Studio 的功能「视频色彩调整」：按素材配置 LUT，分别调整高光、阴影、肤色和选定色相；在工作台预览后可提交导出任务。
DSH Video Studio 的功能「Harness 工具操作」：通过视频工具扫描并选择获准目录中的素材、更新调整、请求预览或导出，并查询或取消任务。
DSH Video Studio 使用前须知：只有主动选择画面做 AI 建议时，最多两张 PNG 会交给 Harness 当前配置的模型提供方；该插件不单独保存 API 密钥。

dsh-video-studio README · DSH Video Studio：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

Local video color editing for **DeepSeek Harness**. Open a folder, choose a clip,
restore its camera color, preview optional adjustments, and export a new video.
The Studio combines five features over one shared processing runtime.

This is an early release. The interface is currently in Chinese. Local image
statistics provide optional suggestions; they do not determine creative intent.

dsh-video-studio README · Features：- Camera/profile-aware DJI D-Log, D-Log M and D-Log2 LUT matching. Vivid / Size 65
  is preferred when available; choose another registered look or size.
- Independent highlights and shadows, optional stronger low-light lift,
  approximate time-range suggestions and manual control.
- Optional spatial denoising, face-guided skin brightness/smoothing, and
  selective color controls. Adjustments start unset and suggestions require acceptance.
- Current-frame previews, original-size inspection, source playback and bounded
  processed playback clips. Collapse material and adjustment panels for viewing.
- Optional, page-specific AI advice through Harness's configured models.
  Image sharing is opt-in; no separate API key is stored by this plugin.
- Detail-first 10-bit HEVC export, explicit output location, result playback,
  system-player opening and folder reveal. Default destination: the source
  folder's `Output/` directory. Original files are read-only.

dsh-video-studio README · Requirements：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3** with Node.js 22.19+. Complete platform
packages include fixed Python, FFmpeg/ffprobe, NumPy, OpenCV and 18 DJI LUTs.
Customers do not need separate installations of these components.

dsh-video-studio README · Requirements：Choose the architecture of the Harness Host and its Node runtime. Desktop has
a native folder picker; Web needs an explicit source directory grant. The
small universal package includes LUTs and offers a first-launch **配置独立环境**
button, or can use your own Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg/ffprobe 8+. Complete platform
packages need no runtime download on first launch.
See [fixed runtime construction and platform limits](runtime/README.md).

dsh-video-studio README · Install：Download the `.tgz` with the matching platform suffix from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases)
and select it in Harness's plugin installer. This is the prepared distribution;
GitHub's automatically generated source ZIP/tarball does not contain LUT payloads.

For an Apple Silicon Mac, the CLI can install the complete release directly:

dsh-video-studio README · Install：```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-darwin-arm64.tgz'
```

Or install a downloaded package, selecting the profile you actually use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3.tgz

dsh-video-studio README · For a Web Host, use --profile web instead.：```

The bare npm name is not a published installation channel. After installation,
restart Harness when convenient and open **影调工作台** in the sidebar.
Choose a source folder on Desktop. There are no source grants by default.
section: For a Web Host, use --profile web instead.

text:
dsh-video-studio README · Configuration：Add overrides to the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Modify the existing
`hvp-runtime` row; do not insert a second runtime. Paths refer to the **Host's**
filesystem, including when the browser is on another machine.

```yaml
- id: hvp-runtime
  config:
    allowedRoots:
      - /absolute/path/to/videos

dsh-video-studio README · Configuration：`allowedRoots` is required for manual path scanning in Web. Desktop's folder
picker grants access to the folder explicitly selected by the user. Do not
grant an entire drive just to make one folder accessible.

dsh-video-studio README · Configuration：The bundle stores drafts and jobs in `video-studio/` under the active Harness
home (`dshHomePath('video-studio')`), outside installed plugin files.
To relocate it, set `dataDir` on the same runtime row. Keep this directory
across upgrades if you want to preserve drafts and completed export records.

dsh-video-studio README · Bring your own LUTs：The included resources cover the exact mappings in `assets/catalog.json`.
Vivid / Size 65 is preferred where provided; some cameras only have a 33-size
or Standard LUT. D-Log, D-Log M and D-Log2 are never substituted for one another.
See [resource construction and inventory](assets/README.md).

For a separate, custom catalog, override the defaults with:

```yaml
- id: hvp-runtime
  config:
    assets:
      catalog_path: /absolute/path/to/video-luts/catalog.json

dsh-video-studio README · Bring your own LUTs：Obtain a **3D CUBE → Rec.709** LUT for the exact camera and Log
profile. From a source checkout, register it with:

```sh
npm run catalog -- --file /path/to/vivid.cube \
  --camera pocket4p --profile dlog2 --look vivid \
  --directory /path/to/video-luts
```

dsh-video-studio README · Bring your own LUTs：The command copies the LUT under a SHA-256 filename and writes a version-2
catalog. Use `--append` to add other camera/profile/look/grid mappings. It does
not infer a file's camera or transfer function: the mapping is your declaration.
Profiles: `dlog`, `dlogm`, `dlog2`; looks: `standard`, `vivid`.
Configure `catalog_path` and `lut_root` as above, then reload the plugin.
Already prepared version-2 catalogs remain supported; `assets.library_path`
can optionally add compatible sizes from a schema-1 LUT library.

dsh-video-studio README · Optional face-guided treatment：```sh
python3 -m venv /path/to/video-vision
/path/to/video-vision/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-vision.txt
```

Set `assets.vision_python` to that Python executable. Detection supplies face
candidates, not identities or guaranteed coverage; preview the result before export.
No small neural model or external model weights are required by the baseline.

dsh-video-studio README · Workflow and limits：Select a clip in the left list, confirm restoration, then visit **明暗 → 肤色 →
局部颜色 → 确认**. Each adjustment is optional. Scrub to inspect different
positions, accept only the changes you want, and choose an export destination.

dsh-video-studio README · Workflow and limits：- The working domain is display-referred **SDR Rec.709**. Unknown Log requires
  confirmation and a valid transform; HDR HLG/PQ and RAW mastering are not supported.
- Tone suggestions use sparse RGB16 samples, not exact shot detection or
  object tracking. They are based on the restored baseline, before manual edits.
  Accepted ranges use fixed controls with short boundary transitions.
- Low-light lift amplifies existing information and noise. Spatial denoising
  can soften fine texture; it is optional and has no temporal denoising model.
- Fast reduced previews and original-size processing can differ. HEVC playback
  depends on browser/OS codecs. Original-size 4K processing is **not real-time**.
- Detail-first export checks that encoding preserves the processed YUV420p10
  frames. This does not make LUTs or chroma conversion reversible. Files may be
  much larger than the source; the explicitly selected fast mode is lossy.
- AI suggestions may be wrong. They change only the current page's controls
  after acceptance; enabling image analysis shares sampled frames with the
  provider selected in Harness.

dsh-video-studio README · Independent features：The default bundle loads one runtime plus the full Studio. Package subpaths
also expose `lut-batch`, `tone`, `skin`, `local-color` and `finish`. For example,
to register only tone tools instead of all Studio tools, add:

```yaml
- id: hvp-studio
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: hvp-tone

dsh-video-studio README · Independent features：Keep `hvp-runtime` enabled. The shared client shows available features; these
entries do not create independent databases or chain five video encodes.
Tool names are `video_lut_batch`, `video_tone`, `video_skin`,
`video_local_color`, `video_finish` and, for the aggregate entry, `video_studio`.

dsh-video-studio README · Build from source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio.git
cd dsh-video-studio
npm run assets:prepare -- --download
npm run build

dsh-video-studio README · Build from source：The bundled LUTs come from DJI's official downloads. Resource preparation downloads the pinned resource archive,
verifies its locked SHA-256 and every original LUT's hash/size. Original DJI
HTTPS sources and ZIP members remain in the manifest; use
`--download --official-only` to fetch those directly. For an offline build,
replace `--download` with `--source /path/to/luts`.
The source directory must contain the SHA-named files in the manifest.

dsh-video-studio README · Build from source：The build refuses missing, modified or wrong-grid LUTs, then copies the runtime
and exact resources into `dist/`. It uses Node's standard library; no adjacent
Harness/lut-app checkout or frontend compiler is required. The client resolves
React from Harness. The resulting package runs without downloading LUTs at runtime.
See [the full resource build recipe](assets/README.md) for origin, counts,
prerequisites and release construction.

dsh-video-studio README · Build from source：A standalone local UI is also available without Harness AI integration:

```sh
npm start -- --input-root /absolute/path/to/videos --data-dir /path/to/standalone-data
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4319/hvp/`. Camera LUT options are `--catalog`,
`--lut-root` and optionally `--library`; face treatment uses `--vision-python`.
The standalone server is local-only and has no native folder picker.

dsh-video-studio README · Build from source：```text
index.mjs / client.js / cordis.patch.yml  Harness package entry points
adapters/harness/                       Host tool and AI integration
bundles/ / plugins/                     Shared runtime and feature entries
src/                                   Jobs, permissions, storage and HTTP

dsh-video-studio README · License：Original project source: **MIT**, copyright Peng Junchen.
See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for external dependencies
and resource sources. This is an independent community plugin, not an official
DeepSeek, DJI or CapCut product.

dsh-video-studio README · DSH Video Studio · 影调工作台：[English](README.md) · [MIT 协议](LICENSE)

面向 **DeepSeek Harness** 的本地视频调色插件。选择文件夹和素材，确认相机
色彩还原，按需调整明暗、肤色与颜色，预览后导出新视频。统一工作台和五个
功能入口共用一个处理服务。

当前为早期版本，界面使用中文。本地统计提供可选参考，不能判断用户的创作意图。
section: DSH Video Studio · 影调工作台

text:
dsh-video-studio README · 功能：- 按相机与拍摄格式匹配 DJI D-Log、D-Log M、D-Log2 还原 LUT；有对应资源时
  优先 Vivid／Size 65，可切换已注册的风格和尺寸。
- 高光、暗部分别调整；可选更强的暗光增强、近似时间区间建议和手动控制。
- 可选空间降噪、人脸候选引导的肤色明亮／光滑处理、局部颜色调整。
  调整默认未设置，建议需用户采纳。
- 当前帧预览、原尺寸放大、原片播放与按需生成的处理后短片。
  素材列表和调整面板可收起，扩大观看空间。
- 明暗、肤色、局部颜色页提供可选 AI 建议，使用 Harness 已配置的模型。
  发送画面需主动选择，插件不另外保存 API 密钥。
- 默认 10-bit HEVC 细节优先导出，可选择保存位置；结果直接显示路径、视频、
  系统播放器和文件夹入口。默认保存到原片目录的 `Output/`，原片只读。

dsh-video-studio README · 环境要求：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2／rc.3**（Node.js 22.19+）。完整系统包自带固定的
Python、FFmpeg／ffprobe、NumPy、OpenCV 和 18 个 DJI LUT，无需客户另外安装。
Desktop 提供系统文件夹选择器，Web 需明确配置素材目录。

dsh-video-studio README · 环境要求：| 完整安装包 | 系统要求 |
| --- | --- |
| [darwin-arm64](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-darwin-arm64.tgz) | macOS 13+，Apple Silicon |
| [darwin-x64](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-darwin-x64.tgz) | macOS 13+，Intel |
| [win32-x64](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-win32-x64.tgz) | Windows 10 22H2+，x64 |
| [linux-x64](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-linux-x64.tgz) | Ubuntu 22.04+／glibc 2.35+，x86-64 |

dsh-video-studio README · 环境要求：按 Harness Host 所在机器及其 Node 架构选择安装包。轻量通用包只含 LUT，可在
首次启动的“运行环境”区域点击“配置独立环境”，也可使用自己准备的 Python 3.10+
及 FFmpeg／ffprobe 8+。完整包启动时不需要下载环境。
详细版本、构建方式和平台限制见[独立运行环境说明](runtime/README.md)。

dsh-video-studio README · 安装：从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases)
下载带对应系统后缀的完整 `.tgz`，在 Harness 插件安装界面选择该文件。GitHub 自动生成的源码
ZIP／tarball 不包含 LUT 载荷，不能当作完整安装包。

例如 Apple Silicon Mac 可直接安装：

```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.3/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3-darwin-arm64.tgz'
```

使用已下载文件时，请选择自己实际使用的 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-video-studio-0.1.0-beta.3.tgz

dsh-video-studio README · 使用 Web Host 时，将 desktop 改为 web。：```

当前未发布到 npm，请使用 GitHub 地址或安装包。安装后在合适时重启 Harness，
打开侧栏的 **影调工作台**。Desktop 首次使用点击“选择文件夹”；默认不授予
任何素材目录访问权。
section: 使用 Web Host 时，将 desktop 改为 web。

text:
dsh-video-studio README · 配置：在当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖已有 `hvp-runtime` 行，
不要重复插入运行时。路径均指 **Host 所在机器**，包括浏览器在其它机器的情况。

```yaml
- id: hvp-runtime
  config:
    allowedRoots:
      - /absolute/path/to/videos

Web 手动输入路径扫描时需要 `allowedRoots`。Desktop 文件夹选择器为用户明确
选中的目录授予访问权；只配置实际需要的素材目录。

草稿和任务默认存储在当前 Harness home 下的 `video-studio/`
（`dshHomePath('video-studio')`），不写入插件安装目录。
可在同一运行时行设置 `dataDir` 更换位置；升级时保留该目录，可保留草稿和
已完成导出记录。

dsh-video-studio README · 注册自有 LUT：随包资源覆盖 `assets/catalog.json` 的精确映射，有对应资源时优先 Vivid／Size 65；
部分相机只有 Size 33 或普通风格。D-Log、D-Log M、D-Log2 不混用。
清单与构建方法见[资源构建说明](assets/README.md)。

只有需要使用自己的独立目录时，才覆盖随包默认资源：

```yaml
- id: hvp-runtime
  config:
    assets:
      catalog_path: /absolute/path/to/video-luts/catalog.json

请取得准确对应相机和 Log 格式的 **3D CUBE → Rec.709** 还原 LUT。
在源码目录中运行：

```sh
npm run catalog -- --file /path/to/vivid.cube \
  --camera pocket4p --profile dlog2 --look vivid \
  --directory /path/to/video-luts
```

dsh-video-studio README · 注册自有 LUT：脚本按 SHA-256 文件名复制 LUT，生成 version 2 catalog。加入其它相机、格式、
风格或尺寸时使用 `--append`。脚本不猜测相机或传递函数，映射由使用者明确提供。
格式支持 `dlog`、`dlogm`、`dlog2`，风格支持 `standard`、`vivid`。
随后按上方配置填写 `catalog_path` 和 `lut_root` 并重新加载插件。
已有 version 2 catalog 可继续使用；`assets.library_path` 可从 schema 1 LUT
library 补充同版本、同映射的其它尺寸。

dsh-video-studio README · 高级：使用自己的 Python 环境：完整系统包已包含人物处理依赖。只有希望指定自己的环境时，才需要以下步骤。

```sh
python3 -m venv /path/to/video-vision
/path/to/video-vision/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-vision.txt
```

将 `assets.vision_python` 指向该 Python。检测提供人脸候选，不识别人身份，
也不保证完整跟踪覆盖，导出前应预览。本地基础功能无需神经网络模型或外部权重。
section: 高级：使用自己的 Python 环境

text:
dsh-video-studio README · 操作与能力边界：在左侧选择素材后，依次查看 **色彩还原 → 明暗 → 肤色 → 局部颜色 → 确认**。
各项均可跳过。拖动时间条查看不同位置，只采纳需要的建议，最后选择位置导出。

dsh-video-studio README · 操作与能力边界：- 工作域为显示相对的 **SDR Rec.709**。未知 Log 需要确认及有效还原变换，
  暂不支持 HLG／PQ 转 SDR 或 RAW／HDR 母版制作。
- 明暗建议来自少量 RGB16 抽帧，依据为 LUT 后、手动调整前的画面；
  不是精确镜头检测或物体追踪。已确认区间保持固定参数，边界短暂平滑过渡。
- 暗光增强会放大已有信息及噪点；空间降噪可能柔化细弱纹理，默认关闭，
  当前没有时域降噪模型。
- 缩小预览和原尺寸处理可能有差异；HEVC 播放取决于浏览器及系统解码能力。
  原尺寸 4K 处理**未达到实时**。
- 细节优先导出检查编码前后已处理 YUV420p10 帧的一致性，不代表 LUT 或色度
  转换可逆。文件可能明显大于原片；主动选择的快速模式为有损编码。
- AI 可能判断错误，只在明确采纳后修改当前页设置；选择发送画面时，
  代表帧会交给 Harness 中选定的模型提供方。

dsh-video-studio README · 独立功能入口：默认 bundle 加载一个运行时和完整 Studio。包的子路径另提供
`lut-batch`、`tone`、`skin`、`local-color`、`finish`。
例如只注册明暗工具，可在 profile patch 中写：

```yaml
- id: hvp-studio
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: hvp-tone

保留 `hvp-runtime`。共享界面按已启用功能呈现；这些入口不建立五套数据库，
也不串联五次编码。工具名为 `video_lut_batch`、`video_tone`、`video_skin`、
`video_local_color`、`video_finish`，聚合入口另提供 `video_studio`。

dsh-video-studio README · 源码构建：```sh
git clone https://github.com/PengJunchen/dsh-video-studio.git
cd dsh-video-studio
npm run assets:prepare -- --download
npm run build

随包 LUT 来自 DJI 官方下载。资源准备从固定资源包获取文件，先检查资源包 SHA-256，再
检查每个原始 LUT 的散列和字节大小。原始官方 URL／ZIP 成员仍在清单中，可用
`--download --official-only` 直接获取。离线构建将 `--download` 换成
